title: 4. Campaign Tracking — Offline
description: Synthetic profile composition; no verified campaign exposure, save rate, ROI or uplift.

list.name: platform
list.label: Platform
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(platform, '') AS __text, COALESCE(platform, '') AS __value FROM offline_users ORDER BY 1

list.name: country
list.label: Country
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(country, '') AS __text, COALESCE(country, '') AS __value FROM offline_users ORDER BY 1

list.name: channel
list.label: Channel
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(acquisition_channel, '') AS __text, COALESCE(acquisition_channel, '') AS __value FROM offline_users ORDER BY 1

list.name: goal
list.label: Goal
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(onboarding_goal, '') AS __text, COALESCE(onboarding_goal, '') AS __value FROM offline_users ORDER BY 1

list.name: flow
list.label: Flow
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(flow, '') AS __text, COALESCE(flow, '') AS __value FROM offline_users ORDER BY 1

list.name: test
list.label: Test
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(ab_test, '') AS __text, COALESCE(ab_test, '') AS __value FROM offline_users ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Placement and flow composition
panels.description: Recorded profile fields; not verified views or exposures.

targets.rawSql: SELECT u.placement AS "Placement", u.flow AS "Flow", COUNT(*)::integer AS "Users" FROM offline_users u WHERE $__timeFilter(u.install_at) AND u.platform LIKE '$platform' AND u.country LIKE '$country' AND u.acquisition_channel LIKE '$channel' AND u.onboarding_goal LIKE '$goal' AND u.flow LIKE '$flow' AND COALESCE(u.ab_test, '') LIKE '$test' GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 3 DESC

panels.title: Recorded A/B test names
panels.description: No variant assignment in this archive.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(u.ab_test,'(none)') AS "Test name", COUNT(*)::integer AS "Users" FROM offline_users u WHERE $__timeFilter(u.install_at) AND u.platform LIKE '$platform' AND u.country LIKE '$country' AND u.acquisition_channel LIKE '$channel' AND u.onboarding_goal LIKE '$goal' AND u.flow LIKE '$flow' AND COALESCE(u.ab_test, '') LIKE '$test' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Transaction users by recorded test
panels.description: Descriptive association. Not test conversion, save rate or treatment effect.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(u.ab_test,'(none)') AS "Test name", COUNT(DISTINCT u.user_id)::integer AS "Users", COUNT(DISTINCT t.user_id)::integer AS "Users with transaction" FROM offline_users u LEFT JOIN offline_transactions t ON t.user_id=u.user_id WHERE $__timeFilter(u.install_at) AND u.platform LIKE '$platform' AND u.country LIKE '$country' AND u.acquisition_channel LIKE '$channel' AND u.onboarding_goal LIKE '$goal' AND u.flow LIKE '$flow' AND COALESCE(u.ab_test, '') LIKE '$test' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Outcome measurement status
panels.description: The offline A/B label is insufficient for causal measurement.

targets.rawSql: SELECT 'Unavailable' AS "Measured treatment effect", 'Need verified variant assignment, exposure, mature outcome and control' AS "Reason"
